posting.raw_text:
AI Engineer

Mars Recruitment 
View all jobs
Melbourne VIC (Hybrid)
Engineering - Software (Information & Communication Technology)
Full time
Up to $200000.00 p.a.


An exciting opportunity has become available for an experienced AI DEngineer to join a well-established Australian financial services organisation investing heavily in Generative AI, intelligent automation and modern software engineering.

Working within a newly established capability, you'll play a key role in designing and delivering Generative AI applications, intelligent automations and backend services that support critical business processes across the organisation. This is a hands-on engineering position where you'll take ownership from initial concept through to production deployment, partnering closely with business stakeholders to deliver practical, scalable solutions that create genuine business value.

What you'll be doing
Designing and building production-ready AI applications and intelligent automation workflows

Developing Generative AI solutions that become part of critical business processes, improving automation, operational efficiency and decision-making

Developing backend services and APIs using Python and modern application frameworks

Building integrations between AI services and enterprise platforms using REST APIs, event-driven patterns and data pipelines

Deploying and supporting cloud-based AI workloads, ensuring reliability, observability and operational performance

Working closely with business stakeholders throughout solution design, UAT and production rollout

Contributing to reusable components, deployment standards and engineering best practices

About you
You'll be a software engineer with strong backend development experience and proven exposure to building production-ready AI-enabled applications within commercial environments.

You'll bring experience across a combination of:

Strong Python development using modern frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask

Hands-on experience designing, building or deploying Generative AI applications, including technologies such as LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI orchestration or agent-based workflows

Experience integrating applications and enterprise platforms using REST APIs, event-driven architectures and data pipelines

Cloud platform experience, with Azure highly regarded

CI/CD, Git, Docker and modern software engineering practices

SQL and working with both structured and unstructured data

Exposure to automation technologies and workflow platforms will be viewed favourably

Most importantly, you'll enjoy solving complex business problems, collaborating directly with stakeholders and delivering production-ready solutions that become part of critical business processes.

What's on offer
Opportunity to join a growing AI capability with significant executive backing

Greenfield initiatives with genuine ownership and influence

Modern engineering environment focused on delivering production-ready AI solutions

Collaborative, high-performing team with strong technical leadership

Competitive salary package with flexible hybrid working

If you're passionate about building practical Generative AI solutions that solve real business problems and want to help shape the next generation of enterprise applications, we'd love to hear from you.

posting.raw_text:
AI Engineer

Mars Recruitment 
View all jobs
Melbourne VIC (Hybrid)
Engineering - Software (Information & Communication Technology)
Full time
Up to $200000.00 p.a.


An exciting opportunity has become available for an experienced AI DEngineer to join a well-established Australian financial services organisation investing heavily in Generative AI, intelligent automation and modern software engineering.

Working within a newly established capability, you'll play a key role in designing and delivering Generative AI applications, intelligent automations and backend services that support critical business processes across the organisation. This is a hands-on engineering position where you'll take ownership from initial concept through to production deployment, partnering closely with business stakeholders to deliver practical, scalable solutions that create genuine business value.

What you'll be doing
Designing and building production-ready AI applications and intelligent automation workflows

Developing Generative AI solutions that become part of critical business processes, improving automation, operational efficiency and decision-making

Developing backend services and APIs using Python and modern application frameworks

Building integrations between AI services and enterprise platforms using REST APIs, event-driven patterns and data pipelines

Deploying and supporting cloud-based AI workloads, ensuring reliability, observability and operational performance

Working closely with business stakeholders throughout solution design, UAT and production rollout

Contributing to reusable components, deployment standards and engineering best practices

About you
You'll be a software engineer with strong backend development experience and proven exposure to building production-ready AI-enabled applications within commercial environments.

You'll bring experience across a combination of:

Strong Python development using modern frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask

Hands-on experience designing, building or deploying Generative AI applications, including technologies such as LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI orchestration or agent-based workflows

Experience integrating applications and enterprise platforms using REST APIs, event-driven architectures and data pipelines

Cloud platform experience, with Azure highly regarded

CI/CD, Git, Docker and modern software engineering practices

SQL and working with both structured and unstructured data

Exposure to automation technologies and workflow platforms will be viewed favourably

Most importantly, you'll enjoy solving complex business problems, collaborating directly with stakeholders and delivering production-ready solutions that become part of critical business processes.

What's on offer
Opportunity to join a growing AI capability with significant executive backing

Greenfield initiatives with genuine ownership and influence

Modern engineering environment focused on delivering production-ready AI solutions

Collaborative, high-performing team with strong technical leadership

Competitive salary package with flexible hybrid working

If you're passionate about building practical Generative AI solutions that solve real business problems and want to help shape the next generation of enterprise applications, we'd love to hear from you.
